info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Management Customer Positions-spec
info.description: The Customer Positions Retrieval API provides a means for users to access detailed information regarding customer positions within account management systems. This API allows for the inquiry of current data related to customer holdings and their associated accounts. Typical consumers include financial institutions and account managers who require insights into their clients' investment statuses. By leveraging this API, users can streamline the process of portfolio analysis and enhance decision-making capabilities.

get.description: Fetches detailed information regarding the position of a specific customer within the account management system. This endpoint provides valuable insights into customer status and related metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the customer position details. This JSON object must adhere to the specified schema to ensure the correct functioning of the API.

ListAccountManagementCustomerPositionsRe.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to customer positions in account management.

ListAccountManagementCustomerPositionsRe.title: Customer Position Response

items.description: A list of customer account positions.

sort.description: Sorting information for the retrieved items.

ListAccountManagementCustomerPositionsRe.description: Schema representing the response of the customer position request, including account details, pagination, sorting, and metadata.

CustomerAccountPosition.title: Customer Account Position

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

currency.description: The currency of the ledger balance.

ledgerBalance.description: The balance of the account on the ledger date.

recordStatus.description: The status of the account record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the account position.
